TZA.note: Article covers a bank's cross-border payment service, not public procurement.

facts.fact: UBA Tanzania launched PAPSS cross-border payments in Tanzania, with its payments manager saying the central banks of participating countries oversee their respective financial systems and exchange rates.

TZA.note: States fee and limits of a bank service only; no consumer rules, complaints body or enforcement.
No government payments to people mentioned.
No survey of account holding stated.
Covers cross-border bank transfers of UBA account holders, not mobile money or domestic retail payments.
No tax or fee payment mentioned.
